title: Rest, boundaries and reviews that keep your plan working

say: Rest, boundaries and reviews that keep your plan working.
This is the video for Module 4, Balance, Boundaries and Wellbeing.
Many women are praised for never resting. But a tired mind makes more mistakes, takes longer over tasks and gets irritable more easily.
Rest is maintenance, like servicing a generator so it keeps running.

panel.heading: Rest is maintenance, not laziness
items: A tired mind makes more mistakes
Most adults need 7 or more hours of sleep
Plans fail when the planner is exhausted

say: Most adults need 7 or more hours of sleep a night. Choose a fixed bedtime and wake time, stop screens 30 minutes before bed, and switch on your phone's Bedtime mode or Sleep Focus.

say: For example, Mercy makes bead jewellery in Calabar. She worked from 6 am to midnight and was making mistakes in her orders.
She set a bedtime of 11 pm and a wake time of 6 am, giving 7 hours.

panel.heading: Mercy adds rest and keeps her output
items: Bedtime 11 pm, wake 6 am: 7 hours
Work 25 minutes, break 5 minutes
30-minute lunch away from the table
Sunday afternoon free for rest and family
Errors fell from about 4 a week to 1

say: She worked in Pomodoro rounds. 25 minutes focused on one task, then a 5-minute break to stretch or drink water. After four rounds, a longer break. A good break means stepping away, not scrolling.

say: A boundary is a standing rule about what you will and will not do, and when.
Step one. Notice where you feel resentful, rushed or drained again and again. That is often where a boundary is missing.

panel.heading: How to set a boundary
items: Notice the pressure point
Decide a specific rule
Say it once, clearly and kindly
Support it with tools
Keep it, calmly repeating it

say: Step two. Make it specific. Not I need more time, but no customer calls after 8 pm.

panel.heading: How to set a boundary
items: Notice the pressure point
Decide a specific rule
Say it once, clearly and kindly
Support it with tools
Keep it, calmly repeating it

say: Step three. Say it once, kindly. From next week, I will take orders between 8 am and 7 pm.

panel.heading: How to set a boundary
items: Notice the pressure point
Decide a specific rule
Say it once, clearly and kindly
Support it with tools
Keep it, calmly repeating it

say: Step four. Support it with tools: business hours and an away message in WhatsApp Business, or a sign on the shop door.

panel.heading: How to set a boundary
items: Notice the pressure point
Decide a specific rule
Say it once, clearly and kindly
Support it with tools
Keep it, calmly repeating it

say: Step five. Keep it. Repeat it calmly without long explanations. Otherwise exceptions quickly become the new rule.
For example, Tolu in Abeokuta set hours of 8 am to 7 pm. After a month her sales were the same, and she slept before midnight.

panel.rule: True emergencies are the only exceptions.

say: Mixing business and home money is one of the most common reasons small businesses struggle. When stock money pays for groceries, you cannot see your profit.
So keep a separate business account, and keep restock money aside.
Then pay yourself a fixed amount into the household each week or month. For example, Zainab, a home baker in Abuja, moves a fixed 25,000 naira every Saturday. Figures are illustrative.
Know the signs of burnout: exhaustion, feeling distant or negative about your work, and getting less done, for weeks.

cards.d: Exhaustion, negativity about your work and reduced effectiveness, for weeks.
Talk to someone you trust and see a doctor or health worker. Asking for help is sensible.
If a boundary meets threats or violence, speak to someone you trust and seek help.

say: On the first weekend of each month, score six areas from 1 to 5: health and rest, family, money, work or business, home, and faith, learning and community.

panel.heading: Your monthly review
items: Score six life areas from 1 to 5
Write one sentence for each score
Fix the lowest area with one small step
Every three months, a longer reset

say: Write why you gave each score, then choose one small improvement for the lowest area and put it in next week's plan.

panel.heading: Your monthly review
items: Score six life areas from 1 to 5
Write one sentence for each score
Fix the lowest area with one small step
Every three months, a longer reset

say: Every three months, take about two hours. Choose one or two goals, and remove at least one commitment.
For example, Chiamaka saw family time dropping as sales rose, so she protected Sunday afternoons and handed over a club role.

say: To remember. Protect your sleep. Work in rounds with real breaks. Make boundaries specific and keep them. Separate business money from home money. And review every month, so your systems change as your life changes.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Protect 7 or more hours of sleep
Work in rounds with real breaks
Boundaries: specific, kind, kept
Separate business and household money
Review monthly, reset every three months
